# Complete `_quarto.yml` configuration {.appendix #sec-yaml-config-file}

This appendix reproduces and comments on the `_quarto.yml` file in its entirety,
for quick reference.

## Document metadata for the cover page

```yaml
book:
  title: "Thesis title"
  subtitle: "Optional subtitle"        # remove if absent
  author: "First LAST"
  downloads: [pdf]                     # PDF button in the HTML sidebar

date-soutenance: "12 June 2026"        # DO NOT use date:
discipline: "60th CNU section — Mechanics, mechanical engineering, civil engineering"
specialite: "Acoustics"
ecole-doctorale: "Sciences des Métiers de l'Ingénieur"
laboratoire: "MACS Laboratory, Cnam Paris"
directeur: "Prof. First LAST, Full Professor, Cnam Paris"
cotutelle: false

dedicace: "Optional dedication…"       # remove if absent
```

## Jury composition for the cover page

```yaml
jury:
  - nom: "Ms First LAST"
    titre: "Title, Research Unit, Institution"
    role: "Chair"
  - nom: "Mr First LAST"
    titre: "Title, Research Unit, Institution"
    role: "Reviewer"
  - nom: "Ms First LAST"
    titre: "Title, Research Unit, Institution"
    role: "Reviewer"
  - nom: "Mr First LAST"
    titre: "Associate Professor HDR, Unit, Institution"
    role: "Examiner"
  - nom: "Mr First LAST"
    titre: "Full Professor, MACS, Cnam Paris"
    role: "Thesis supervisor"
```

## Infrastructure section options

```yaml
glossaire: true          # true = loads the LaTeX glossaries package
pagestyle-sections: true # true = roman/arabic/Roman numbering per section
bibliography-manual: true
minitoc-newpage: false   # true = page break after each mini-TOC
chapter-openright: true  # false = for digital version without right-hand page
index: false             # true = generates an index via \index{term}
```

## Collaborative comments

```yaml
comments:
  enabled: true          # false before final deposit on theses.fr
  show_author: true
  authors:
    author:
      name: "First LAST"
      color_html: "#005EA5"
      color_latex: "blue!20"
    supervisor:
      name: "Supervisor"
      color_html: "#D55E00"
      color_latex: "orange!30"
```

## Python execution

```yaml
execute:
  freeze: auto    # recomputes only if the chunk code changes
  echo: true      # shows code by default (overridable per chunk)
```

# PDF/A-1b validation and deposit on theses.fr {.appendix #sec-pdfa}

The French national thesis repository [theses.fr](https://theses.fr) requires a
PDF/A-1b file (ISO 19005-1). The PDF produced by this template is designed to meet
the criteria used by CINES — the body responsible for institutional archiving of
French doctoral theses.

## Official validator: facile.cines.fr

**[facile.cines.fr](https://facile.cines.fr)** (CINES) is the reference validator
for deposit on theses.fr. It — not third-party tools — determines whether your PDF
will be accepted. Simply upload the PDF to obtain an immediate report.

## Automated check from the post-render script

The post-render script can query the CINES web service automatically.
Simply set `validate: true` in `_quarto-en.yml`:

```yaml
# In _quarto-en.yml — before depositing to theses.fr:
validate: true
```

Then render as usual:

```bash
quarto render --profile en --to cnam-thesis-pdf
```

The script sends the PDF to the CINES web service and displays the result:

```
Validating PDF/A on facile.cines.fr (CINES)...
✅  PDF/A-1b valide — archivable sur theses.fr.
```

If the PDF fails:

```
❌  PDF/A-1b non valide.
    → Corriger via : https://facile.cines.fr/#correction
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## After validation

Set `validate: false` back in `_quarto-en.yml` for day-to-day builds —
the web service call is only needed before the final deposit.
:::

## If validation fails

Use the official correction service:
**[facile.cines.fr/#correction](https://facile.cines.fr/#correction)**.
It automatically corrects the most common non-conformities
with no additional software to install.
